top5.titleKo: Jeff Koons to Auction $100 Million of Personal Art Collection
top5.summaryKo: Jeff Koons is set to sell eight paintings and a sculpture from his personal collection worth a collective $100 million at auction, the New York Times reports. The sale is being handled by Christie’s and will take place in New York on November 17 at the house’s evening twentieth-century sale. Titled

top5.titleOriginal: Mayor Mamdani Doubles Grants for New York Artists
top5.titleKo: Mayor Mamdani Doubles Grants for New York Artists
top5.summaryKo: New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani and the New York City Department of Cultural Affairs (DCLA) have announced an increase in city-funded grants for individual artists and small nonprofits, from five thousand dollars to ten thousand. This is the first increase in grant awards in nearly twenty years.
